4321|c5ceacbe.name: Baldruc
4321|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4967|c46890e2.name: Archmage Tervosh
4967|c46890e2.text: Well met, $N. We must be brief because there is much to do.

1267-complete.name: Lady Jaina Proudmoore
1267-complete.text:
Let me be first to thank you for all you've done, $N. You have been an incredible blessing to my people and the people of Stormwind. I am sorry I couldn't make your acquaintance under better circumstances.

Understand also that I cannot overtly thank you for your efforts, but I assure you again, it is appreciated.

When you visit Theramore in the future, seek me out and I shall try to keep you apprised of the situation.

Thank you again, $N.
1267-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1324-complete.name: Archmage Tervosh
1324-complete.text:
I assure you, we're all quite upset about current events, but allow us to take him back to Theramore for some questioning, and we'll see about finding the King.

I'm sure my lady Proudmoore would like to thank you for your help. Speak to her when you have a moment.
1324-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat
